name: unipaper-bridge
description: Research papers autonomously, trying lawful open access first and local institutional access only when full text is otherwise unreadable.

interface.shortDescription: Research papers with an automatic library fallback
interface.longDescription: Runs the normal scholarly research workflow, verifies whether full text is actually readable, and automatically opens the isolated local KHU browser only as a last-mile fallback. It never returns university credentials, cookies, sessions, or licensed full text through MCP.
defaultPrompt: Research this paper and automatically use my configured university access only if lawful public full text is unavailable.
이 주제의 핵심 논문을 조사하고 원문을 못 읽을 때만 설정된 경희대 로컬 접속을 자동으로 사용해줘.
